local target=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(129,35),'recipient Temple city missing')
local recipient=assert(Players[1])
local capital=assert(recipient:GetCities():GetCapitalCity())
local temple=assert(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_TEMPLE)
assert(recipient:IsHuman() and recipient:GetCities():GetCount()>1
  and target:GetOwner()==1 and (capital:GetX()~=129 or capital:GetY()~=35)
  and target:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(temple.Index),
  'recipient city cannot be borrowed without losing the capital')
assert(assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI).ReadCity(1,target:GetID(),'WORK',temple.Index,0)==-1,
  'target Temple slot is occupied')

steps.code:
local source=assert(Players[2]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity())
local target=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(129,35))
local palace=assert(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_PALACE)
local temple=assert(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_TEMPLE)
assert(source:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(palace.Index,0)==2
  and target:GetOwner()==2 and target:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(temple.Index,0)==-1,
  'source or borrowed target is not ready for MOVE')
local params={}
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_PLAYER_ONE]=2
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_SRC]=source:GetID()
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_DEST]=target:GetID()
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_SRC]=palace.Index
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_DEST]=temple.Index
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GREAT_WORK_INDEX]=2
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_SLOT]=0
print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_ALT_REQUEST] human='..tostring(Game.GetLocalPlayer())
  ..' requestActor=1 playerParam=2 source='..source:GetID()..' target='..target:GetID())
local ok,value=pcall(UI.RequestPlayerOperation,1,PlayerOperations.MOVE_GREAT_WORK,params)
print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_ALT_RETURN] ok='..tostring(ok)..' value='..tostring(value))
assert(ok,'MOVE request raised an error')
return 'issued one official MOVE for the AI-owned work in a disposable game'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local proof=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_AI_PALACE_ALT_PROBE'))
local works=A.NativeWorkLocations(2)
local positions={}
for _,work in ipairs(works) do
  positions[#positions+1]=tostring(work.Owner)..':'..tostring(work.CityID)..':'
    ..tostring(work.BuildingType)..':'..tostring(work.Slot)
end
print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_ALT_LOCATION] count='..#works..' positions='..table.concat(positions,';'))
assert(#works==1,'one-shot official MOVE lost or duplicated the acquired work')
local work=works[1]
for _,key in ipairs({'Index','GreatWorkType','ObjectType','CreatorName','TurnCreated','CreatedByPlayer'}) do
  assert(work[key]==proof.Source[key],'acquired work provenance changed: '..key)
end
assert(A.Rules.Equal(work.Effects,proof.Source.Effects),'acquired work effects changed')
if work.Owner==2 and work.X==129 and work.Y==35 and work.BuildingType=='BUILDING_TEMPLE' then
  local target=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(129,35))
  Game:SetProperty('JAC_AI_PALACE_ALT_RESULT','MOVED')
  CityManager.TransferCity(target,1)
  assert(assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(129,35)):GetOwner()==1,'target city return failed')
  print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_ALT_RETURN_CITY] returned=true')
  return 'MOVE arrived in borrowed Temple; returned the disposable city'
end
assert(work.Owner==2 and work.X==proof.Source.X and work.Y==proof.Source.Y
  and work.BuildingType=='BUILDING_PALACE','official MOVE reached an unexpected slot')
Game:SetProperty('JAC_AI_PALACE_ALT_RESULT','UNOBSERVED')
print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_ALT_RETURN_CITY] returned=false pending-or-rejected request; disposable game will exit')
return 'no MOVE observed; left the disposable borrowed city unsaved'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local outcome=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_AI_PALACE_ALT_RESULT'))
local work=A.NativeWorkLocations(2)
assert(#work==1,'acquired work lost or duplicated after observation')
if outcome=='MOVED' then
  assert(work[1].Owner==1 and work[1].X==129 and work[1].Y==35
    and work[1].BuildingType=='BUILDING_TEMPLE',
    'acquired work did not survive the recipient city return')
else
  assert(outcome=='UNOBSERVED' and work[1].Owner==2
    and work[1].BuildingType=='BUILDING_PALACE',
    'pending or rejected MOVE changed after observation')
end
print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_ALT_FINAL] outcome='..outcome..' owner='..work[1].Owner
  ..' city='..work[1].CityID)
return 'diagnostic outcome '..outcome..' from one official MOVE request'
